descriptionChirho: An adjective describing moral badness, worthlessness, or evil quality in persons or actions. The multilingual translations are uniform across all grammatical inflections (singular/plural, nominative/accusative): spa 'malo/malas-cosas/vil', hin 'bura/bure' (bad/evil), arb 'sharran/sayyi'an/radi'' (evil/bad/worthless), kor 'akhan' (evil/wicked), swa 'baya/mabaya/ovu' (bad/evil). No semantic distinction emerges between the singular (S78464, S78466) and plural (S78465) forms; all describe the same quality of moral deficiency or worthlessness.
